mapper.select: SELECT m.mb_no, m.mb_id, m.mb_email, m.mb_name, m.mb_nick, m.mb_nick_date, m.mb_sex, m.mb_birth, m.mb_hp, m.mb_today_login, m.mb_sms, m.mb_alarm_date, m.mb_recommend, m.mb_point, IFNULL(m.mb_point, 0), IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.od_id = 0 AND sc.cp_end > CURRENT_DATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS coupon_cnt, msp.provider, msp.identifier FROM g5_member m INNER JOIN g5_member_social_profiles msp ON m.mb_id = msp.mb_id LEFT OUTER JOIN g5_shop_coupon sc ON sc.mb_id = m.mb_id WHERE msp.identifier = #{identifier} AND msp.provider = #{provider}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g5_member(mb_id, mb_name, mb_nick, mb_email, mb_sex, mb_birth, mb_hp, mb_adult, mb_login_ip, mb_open, mb_ip, mb_mailling, mb_sms, mb_alarm_date, mb_ci, mb_recommend, mb_datetime) VALUES (#{mbId}, #{mbName}, #{mbNick}, #{mbEmail}, #{mbSex}, #{mbBirth}, #{mbHp}, #{mbAdult}, #{mbLoginIp}, #{mbOpen}, #{mbLoginIp}, #{mbMailingSms}, #{mbMailingSms}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{mbCi},#{mbRecommend}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
INSERT INTO g5_member_social_profiles(mb_id, provider, identifier, displayname, mp_register_day) VALUES (#{mbId}, #{provider}, #{identifier}, #{mbNick}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

INSERT INTO g5_point ( mb_id, po_datetime, po_content, po_point, po_use_point, po_expired, po_expire_date, po_mb_point, po_rel_table, po_rel_id, po_rel_action ) VALUES ( #{mbId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{poContent}, #{poPoint}, 0, 0, #{poExpireDate}, #{poMbPoint}, #{poRelTable}, #{mbId}, #{poRelAction} );
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM g5_shop_coupon_log WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND od_id = #{odId};
mapper.select: SELECT u.mb_no, u.mb_id, u.mb_email, u.mb_name, u.mb_nick, u.mb_nick_date, u.mb_email, u.mb_sex, u.mb_birth, u.mb_hp, u.mb_today_login, u.mb_sms, u.mb_ci, u.mb_recommend, u.mb_ci, p.provider, p.identifier FROM g5_member u INNER JOIN g5_member_social_profiles p ON u.mb_id = p.mb_id WHERE u.mb_ci = #{mbCi} AND u.mb_leave_date = '' ORDER BY mb_datetime DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.mb_no, u.mb_id, u.mb_email, u.mb_name, u.mb_nick, u.mb_nick_date, u.mb_email, u.mb_sex, u.mb_birth, u.mb_hp, u.mb_today_login, u.mb_sms, u.mb_alarm_date, u.mb_ci, u.mb_recommend, u.mb_ci, p.provider, p.identifier FROM g5_member u JOIN g5_member_social_profiles p ON u.mb_id = p.mb_id WHERE u.mb_recommend = #{mbRecommend} AND u.mb_leave_date = ''

SELECT u.mb_no, u.mb_id, u.mb_email, u.mb_name, u.mb_nick, u.mb_nick_date, u.mb_email, u.mb_sex, u.mb_birth, u.mb_hp, u.mb_today_login, u.mb_datetime, u.mb_sms, u.mb_alarm_date, u.mb_pet_point, u.mb_recommend, u.mb_ci, u.mb_point, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.od_id = 0 AND sc.cp_end > CURRENT_DATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS coupon_cnt, msp.provider, msp.identifier, bf.bf_fileurl AS user_profile_url FROM g5_member u INNER JOIN g5_member_social_profiles msp ON u.mb_id = msp.mb_id LEFT OUTER JOIN g5_shop_coupon sc ON sc.mb_id = u.mb_id LEFT JOIN g5_board_file bf ON u.mb_no = bf.wr_id AND bf.bo_table = 'user_profile' WHERE msp.identifier = #{identifier} AND sc.cp_id NOT IN (SELECT cp_id FROM g5_shop_coupon_log WHERE mb_id = u.mb_id);
mapper.update: UPDATE g5_member SET mb_name = #{mbName}, mb_sex = #{mbSex}, mb_birth = #{mbBirth}, mb_hp = #{mbHp}, mb_nick = #{mbNick}, mb_ci = #{mbCi} WHERE mb_id = #{mbId}
UPDATE g5_member SET mb_nick = #{nickName}, mb_nick_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE mb_id = #{mbId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g5_member WHERE mb_nick = #{nickName};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_device_info WHERE LENGTH(device_token) > 0 AND mb_id = #{mbId};

SELECT g5p.po_id, pph.mb_id,pph.point,g5p.po_expire_date,gso.od_receipt_price, CASE WHEN (gso.od_receipt_price + gso.od_send_cost + gso.od_receipt_point + gso.od_coupon) - gso.od_cart_price = 0 AND gso.od_misu = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cancel_finish_enabled FROM pet_point_history pph INNER JOIN g5_point g5p ON pph.g5_point_id = g5p.po_id INNER JOIN g5_shop_order gso ON pph.mb_id = gso.mb_id AND pph.od_id = gso.od_id WHERE pph.od_id = #{odId} AND pph.mb_id = #{mbId} AND g5p.po_expire_date >= CURDATE() AND pph.type = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_member_attendance ( mb_id, attendance_date ) SELECT #{mbId}, DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '%Y-%m-%d') FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM pet_member_attendance WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND attendance_date = CURRENT_DATE() );
